what: S31: where the time goes at HD 30 fps on the N6 -- encoder vs muxer vs storage.
board: OpenMV N6 on nereus002, firmware OpenMV v5.0.0-58.ga83bc776f5 (PR #3247 + denoise patch)
conclusion: The ENCODER is not the bottleneck -- 50 fps at HD leaves 66% headroom over 30. mp4.py costs 50 ms/frame on top, which is what caps HD recording at ~13.7 fps. Raising fragment_frames makes it dramatically WORSE (264.9 ms/frame), so that knob is a trap, not a tuning option -- the cost scales with the fragment buffer, which points at GC pressure rather than per-frame work.

storage_on_this_board.sdcard: ENODEV -- /sdcard and /sd both absent. No SD card present on this unit.
storage_on_this_board.implication: There is nowhere on this board to put HD video. /flash's 3 MB does not hold one second of HD at 16 Mbps (~2 MB/s). Anything recorded must leave over USB.

usb_throughput: UNMEASURED -- the attempt hit a raw-REPL refusal and board contact was stopped rather than retried.
